_readme: Admission exams shown in the My exams card (Today) and tagged on the Plan. One line per exam; edit a date or time here and it changes everywhere. date: YYYY-MM-DD (Bangladesh time) · time: 24-hour HH:MM · main: true for MIST · date: null for an exam with no date yet (IUT): the card shows its "when" text until a date is set on its guide page (synced as plan:examdate:<tag>), then it counts down and gets a Plan tag like the others. Exams with a guide page in exam-guides.json open it when tapped. Display only: the study plan and its counters do not read this.
source: Dates/rules from 2025–26 circulars via admission-calendar.com — confirm when 2026–27 circulars publish.
